source: "Don't take this the wrong way, but—what if Hamlet and I began seeing each other again?"
target: “别误会我的意思，但——如果我和哈姆雷特重新交往呢？”

source: "Hamlet—your uncle is not your enemy. Peter Quince is."
target: “哈姆雷特——你的叔叔不是你的敌人。彼得·奎因斯才是。”

source: "I met Simona, and she revealed to me the true culprit—Peter Quince, the playmaster, is behind us being trapped in Elsinore."
target: “我见到了西蒙娜，她告诉了我真正的罪魁祸首是谁——我们被困在埃尔西诺，幕后主使就是戏剧大师彼得·奎因斯。”

source: "This card game you mentioned—it's unpopular with the others?"
target: “你提到的那个纸牌游戏——其他人不喜欢吗？”
